answer: Prayers & Duties >> Sawm (Fasting) Question ID: 7675 Country: United Kingdom Title: A woman who is Fasting the Doctor puts cream in her Vagina does Fast break? Question: Asalamualaikum 1-A woman who is Fasting the Doctor puts cream in her Vagina does Fast break? Answer ID: 7675 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 973/973=M/1429) In the case mentioned above, the fast of the woman will break. الاقطار فی أ قبال النساء یفسد بلا خلاف و ھو الصحیح Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
